items.title: NVO Q3 Earnings Call Highlights GLP-1 Growth and Raised Outlook
items.summary: Novo Nordisk raised its 2026 sales and profit outlook after beating Q3 earnings and revenue estimates, driven by strong obesity treatment demand and accelerating Wegovy pill adoption. The company targets a 2027 CagriSema launch but faces headwinds from U.S. pricing pressure, Ozempic price erosion, and Medicare-dependent growth.
